The '''Custom Podracer''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] piloted by [[Pugwis]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The podracer was fitted with laser cannons and a [[Sonic Boom]] armament. Pugwis entered [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s demolition games on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with his custom podracer.<ref name="demo" />
